verdicts.decision_note: The client unambiguously accepts the proposal for a separate 302-page D2D/Ingram cover variant, establishing the design asset and export scope.
The client identifies a material unresolved D2D cover specification conflict between the expected 0.75-inch spine and the template-generated 0.68-inch spine.
The client explicitly pauses the D2D cover work while awaiting clarification of its cover specifications.
The client confirms the executable D2D cover layout specification of a 0.68-inch spine taken from the supplied D2D template; the administrative $20 addition is correctly excluded.
The instruction to proceed explicitly resumes the previously deferred D2D cover work using the now-confirmed spine specification.
